summary: Iter-4 backend testing complete. 66/66 pytest cases PASS (was 42 in iter-3; added 24 new iter-4 tests). All iter-3 regression preserved. Verified: (1) Kelly position sizing pure-function — zero below min_conf, monotonic w/ confidence, capped at profile.kelly_cap (low=0.25/medium=0.50/high=0.75/extreme=1.00), negative f clamped to 0, returns dict {lot_size, risk_amount, kelly_f, effective_risk_pct}. (2) Regime classifier — CHOP/LOW_VOL_TREND/RANGE/HIGH_VOL_TREND all classified correctly from synthetic indicator dicts; empty input -> 'unknown'; result dict has all 4 required keys. (3) Session detection — Tokyo at 03 UTC, London/NY overlap at 14 UTC (high_volume_window=true), off-hours at 23 UTC, weekend flag correct via `now` arg. (4) Session bias — XAUUSD Tokyo=mean_reversion, XAUUSD overlap=trend_following, BTCUSD weekend=counter_trend, BTCUSD weekday=trend_following. (5) Regime CHOP veto — patched analyze_symbol with mocked LlmChat returning BUY/80% + chop_indicators; result: chart_action=BUY, action=HOLD, veto_applied=true, reasoning contains 'VETO (regime)'. (6) Live AI smoke test (BTCUSD via /api/signals/generate) — 200 OK, includes all new fields (kelly_f, effective_risk_pct, risk_amount, regime{regime,reason,trend_strength,volatility_pct}, session{utc_hour,primary,active_sessions,is_weekend,is_high_volume_window}, session_bias{preferred_strategy,note}); lot_size>=0.01; non-empty reasoning.

minor.issue: PytestRemovedIn10Warning on 4 class-scoped instance-method fixtures (TestSignals.signal_user, TestSignalDualAIShape.sig_user, TestSignalPayloadNewFieldsLive.sig_user, TestTradeBridge.setup_ctx). Not a bug, but should be migrated to @classmethod for pytest 10 compatibility.

critical_code_review_comments: risk.kelly_fraction implements modified Kelly correctly: f* = (p*b - (1-p))/b, clamped at 0, capped at profile_kelly_cap. Payoff_ratio default 2.0 matches spec.

risk.compute_kelly_position_size derives payoff from profile (tp_atr_mult/sl_atr_mult) which is consistent — but note effective_risk_pct uses profile['risk_pct'] * (f / profile['kelly_cap']); means at f==kelly_cap the user gets exactly their profile.risk_pct — by-design as a normalisation but worth a docstring note.

microstructure.classify_regime ordering of branches is correct: trending+high_vol -> HIGH_VOL_TREND; trending+low_vol -> LOW_VOL_TREND; range -> RANGE; high_vol+!trending -> CHOP; else TRANSITIONAL. CHOP correctly requires high_vol AND not is_trending so a high-vol trending market is HIGH_VOL_TREND not CHOP.
microstructure.current_session() supports optional `now` arg as required for deterministic testing; computes primary='london_ny_overlap' when both london+ny active.

ai_signals.analyze_symbol applies regime CHOP veto AFTER dual-AI sentiment veto, both stack into reasoning with distinct 'VETO (news)' / 'VETO (regime)' markers — easy to grep. veto_applied=True if either veto fires.
Signal payload exposes both chart_action (raw model output) and action (post-veto) — good observability.

Minor: ai_signals.py crashes hard if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY env var is missing (KeyError). server boot loads .env so production is fine, but a `os.environ.get(...)` with a clear ValueError would be more graceful.
All backend modules remain <250 lines, well-separated concerns; no DRY violations introduced this iter.
